SALAH Mushaf print layout

Page/line/word layout: QUL (Quranic Universal Library), qpc-v4-tajweed-15-lines and qpc-v4 glyph codes.
https://qul.tarteel.ai/
Packaged SQLite data: NedaaDevs/quran-image-generator, assets release, v4.zip.
https://github.com/NedaaDevs/quran-image-generator
https://github.com/NedaaDevs/quran-image-generator/releases/tag/assets

Quran fonts provided by Quran Foundation. Fonts are requested at runtime from the documented Quran Foundation CDN and are NOT redistributed in this app package.
https://api-docs.quran.foundation/docs/tutorials/fonts/font-rendering/
https://verses.quran.foundation/fonts/quran/hafs/v4/colrv1/woff2/p{PAGE}.woff2

Arabic text for accessible reading: the existing verified Tanzil/Uthmani corpus included in SALAH.
https://tanzil.net

The layout metadata contains source glyph codes and positions. The existing Quran text files are unchanged.
